_note: GilbertOne's six states, from the MyThuso v3 redesign pack Gilbert sent on 29 October 2026 (g1/STATES.md and the state sheet, desktop screen 02). Each state changes the silhouette — the peach blob around the G1 mark and the mark's face — and not only its colour, so a person who cannot tell coral from sand still sees what GilbertOne is doing. The words are the pack's example labels; a screen that uses a state may say something more specific, and always says it in text beside the character, which is aria-hidden. Nothing here is a running assistant.
rule: GilbertOne helps people find their way and tidy notes. It never diagnoses, never interprets readings clinically and never makes care decisions.
reducedMotion: Under reduced motion, a paused page or a hidden tab, each state holds its still pose. The pose is what says what GilbertOne is doing; the movement is only emphasis.

states.label: Visit booked
states.motion: A bounce, and a halo rings out

states.label: No signal, saved on phone
states.motion: Softens and dips, warm and never alarming

_helpersNote: The v3 pack's helper line: GilbertOne beside one sentence, on the screens the pack draws it on. Each sentence orients — where to go, what a switch does, who decides — and none says anything about a person's health. The state is the pose drawn beside it; idle and listen are the only two a screen may hold at rest; found, success and error are each about something that has happened, so a line in one of them is drawn only by the screen that saw it happen (visitOnTheWay only while the visit's own arithmetic has the nurse on her way).

home.text: Here when you need me. I can help you find a screen or a past visit. I can't give health advice.

bookCare.text: Answer one question at a time and I'll show the care you can book. The nurse decides what happens at the visit.

sharing.text: You decide who sees your record. I can show you where each choice is, but I can't change one for you.

passport.text: Your visits, readings and results will live here. Only you decide who sees them.

family.text: Each person keeps their own record. Adults choose what they share with you.

visitDay.text: On the day of your visit I'll show you who is coming and when.

visitOnTheWay.text: Your nurse is on the way. Have your medicines and any letters ready.

devices.text: Nothing is paired to you yet. When a device is, a nurse reviews what it sends. The nurse decides.
